{{Quote|Looks like you used a macro protocol to wipe them all simultaneously. Impressive.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Jaybo Hood|<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>}}
A '''macro protocol''' could be used to [[Memory wipe/Legends|wipe]] the memories<ref name="Jaybo Hood">{{SWE|characters|jaybohood|Jaybo Hood}}</ref> of multiple [[Droid/Legends|droids]] simultaneously. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] from [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], used a macro protocol on a of [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] left behind by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] when they abandoned his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], after which he spent nine [[Standard month/Legends|months]] reprogramming them into his personal servants.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />
